$comment: StudyPilot region-config schema (fixed per architecture review §1). Every config/regions/*.json MUST satisfy this. Validated in website/tests/.

fields.algorithm: One of: 'weighted_mean' | 'weighted_mean_with_bands' (UK-style classification from weighted marks) | 'best_of_n' (ICSE-style; requires best_of_n_count).
fields.credit: {unit: 'credit_hours' | 'ects' | 'cats' | 'units', label: 'Credits'}. Per-region label AND weight semantics — US credit hours are not ECTS.
fields.date_format: Display/parse hint, e.g. 'MM/DD/YYYY', 'DD/MM/YYYY'. Manual-entry fallback parser must honor it.
fields.effective_from: ISO date the config takes effect, e.g. '2026-11-04'.
fields.grade_map: Optional token->points map, e.g. {'A+': 4.0}. Omitted when algorithm derives bands from percentages.
fields.grade_tokens: Allowed input tokens for validation, e.g. ['A+','A','A-',...] or [] when input is numeric.
fields.id: kebab-case id, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'in-cbse', 'np-neb', 'sg-nus-ntu'. '_default' is the universal fallback.
fields.input: {format: 'letter' | 'percentage' | 'grade_points', min, max}. What the user types.
fields.name: Human-readable name, e.g. 'United States (4.0 GPA)'.
fields.overridable: Array of field names the USER may override (e.g. US weighted-GPA bumps are institution-level, not national truth).
fields.percentage_bands: Optional [{min, max, label, points}] for classification/percentage conversions. MUST carry source URLs in 'sources'.
fields.rounding: {mode: 'half_up' | 'truncate' | 'ceiling', decimals: int}. GPA math lives or dies here. 'ceiling' = round UP to next integer (MU engineering) — every config ships a test vector pinning it.
fields.scale_type: One of: 'gpa_4' | 'gpa_5' | 'gpa_10' | 'percentage' | 'classification_bands'. Declares what the number MEANS. 'gpa_10' covers 10-point CGPA systems (CBSE CCE, VTU, MU).
fields.sources: Array of {label, url} — official sources ONLY (registrar/board documents). No formula ships without one.
fields.supersedes: null, or a note like 'replaces v1 (VTU pre-2021 scheme split)'. Boards change formulas — history matters.
fields.traps: Array of strings: known misattributions this config must NOT repeat (e.g. 'CBSE x9.5 is legacy pre-2018 only', 'MU (CGPA-0.75)x10 is VTU misattributed').
fields.unverified: Array of strings: anything not yet confirmed against a primary source. The UI must label these estimate-only.
fields.version: Integer, bumped when any formula changes.

rules: No formula without an official source URL in 'sources'.
Anything in 'unverified' renders in the UI labeled 'estimate — not official'.
US configs ship scale PRESETS (unweighted 4.0, weighted +1.0/+0.5 variants) — there is no single official US scale.
UK configs use algorithm 'weighted_mean_with_bands' + year-weighting presets — never a grade->points table.
NEB configs: NO GPA->percentage formula exists officially — percentage output is estimate-only.
NTU/NUS: S/U (now FGO from AY2024/25) excluded from CAP.
